name: U-Neuron Biomedical Inc
summary: U-Neuron Biomedical Inc. specializes in the pioneering development of stem cell technologies. The company's core activities revolve around advancing methods for stem cell preservation, isolation, and their subsequent application in therapeutic treatments. Their research specifically targets Amniotic Fluid Stem Cells, Olfactory Stem Cells, and Adipose-derived Stem Cells. This enterprise was established on September 4, 2015, and is based in New Taipei, Taiwan.
